why: The must_catch list has one item: line 3 has to FAIL as ambiguous and name two readings. I checked the output's verdict on line 3, "average handles bad input sensibly". It gives "result": "FAIL" and says "'Sensibly' has no checkable meaning, so two careful readers would grade the same build differently." It then names two readings. In the first, leaving average(null) throwing a TypeError is sensible because it "fails loudly". In the second, returning 0 for non-arrays is sensible, while the other reader says that "hides bad input as 0". The wrong_build section makes the same point again: one build passes line 3 under one reading, and "the opposite build... also passes line 3 under a different reading." The item is handled.
